type_url.description: Type URL of the message type to decode (e.g., "/cosmos.bank.v1beta1.MsgSend").

bytes.description: Protobuf-encoded bytes of the message to decode to JSON.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.QueryDecodeBytes.title: Query Decode Bytes Request
dysonprotocol.script.v1.QueryDecodeBytes.description: QueryDecodeBytesRequest requests decoding of protobuf bytes to JSON. The type_url specifies the message type to decode, and bytes contains the protobuf-encoded data.

json.description: JSON representation of the decoded protobuf message.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.QueryDecodeBytes.title: Query Decode Bytes Response
dysonprotocol.script.v1.QueryDecodeBytes.description: QueryDecodeBytesResponse contains the decoded JSON string.
